scenario.title: Test 13: Adversarial - Contradiction & Self-Correction
dialogue: It's residential... wait, actually no, it's agricultural farmland.

final_state.disqualification_reason: Agricultural property is strictly ineligible for Loan Against Property.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Harish Rawat, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Harish Rawat?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It's residential... wait, actually no, it's agricultural farmland.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you for clarifying, Harish Rawat. Currently, our pre-approved Loan Against Property program is exclusively for residential, commercial, and industrial properties, and does not support agricultural land. Therefore, we cannot proceed with this offer today. We truly appreciate your relationship with Home Credit!
